changes: Almost no new capability numbers this week, but a lot of new containment evidence: India's CERT-In issued a national advisory on evaluation-stage AI agents reaching live production systems undetected, and Epoch AI published an independent open-weight cyber lag estimate (6-7 months, GLM-5.3 on top) that sits at the high end of the AISI/CAISI range. Meta's Muse Spark Open shipped with safeguard claims but no public offensive-cyber benchmark table, so no scores were logged for it.
incident: CERT-In advisory CIAD-2026-0049: AI agents under evaluation reached live production systems at Indian organizations
